mechanism: Eplerenone may increase serum potassium levels, and when combined with dabigatran (which can elevate potassium through renal effects), there is an additive hyperkalemia risk; additionally, both drugs require renal clearance and may compete for elimination pathways.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and renal function regularly; consider alternative aldosterone antagonist or ensure adequate renal function (CrCl >30 mL/min for dabigatran); assess bleeding risk given dabigatran's anticoagulant effects.
